clue.text: Game defender with empty gun loaded?

indicators.note: an empty word has lost its contents, so only its outside letters stay
a loaded weapon has its charge put inside it, so something goes into the emptied word

blocks.note: a back is a defensive player in football or rugby
the first and last letters of gun
what a gun is loaded with: ammunition, shortened

explanation.surface: A soldier guarding a position with an unloaded weapon, somehow being reloaded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loaded' does double duty: it supplies the ammunition and also says where it goes, inside the emptied gun.
explanation.definitionFit: Backgammon is a board game for two players moving counters by dice throws.

clue.text: Bishop managed church’s regional office

blocks.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
to run a business is to manage it
CH is the abbreviation for church

explanation.surface: A bishop running the church's diocesan office.
explanation.definitionFit: A branch is a local outlet of a larger organisation, like a bank branch in a town.

clue.text: Drinks dispenser Charlie no longer taking three drugs?

blocks.note: Charlie is C in the NATO phonetic alphabet
to be off something is to have stopped using it
E for ecstasy twice, then pot for cannabis

explanation.surface: A man called Charlie who has given up a cocktail of three drugs.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark is a hint that the 'drugs' are slang: E is ecstasy and pot is cannabis.
explanation.definitionFit: A coffee pot is a jug from which coffee, a hot beverage, is poured.

clue.text: Lass circling ancient sea gets first prize

indicators.note: circling something means going all the way round it, enclosing it

blocks.note: gal is informal for girl
old means ancient, and Med is short for the Mediterranean

explanation.surface: A young woman sailing around the Mediterranean wins top honours.
explanation.definitionFit: A gold medal is awarded for coming first, as at the Olympic Games.

clue.text: Time gran wasted fixing family image projector

indicators.note: wasted means ruined, so these letters are broken up and rebuilt
fixing here means holding firmly in place, so the rearranged letters grip another word

blocks.note: the letters of these words, to be rearranged
a clan is an extended family

explanation.surface: Granny's spent ages fixing the family's old slide projector.
explanation.definitionFit: A magic lantern is an early device that cast pictures from painted glass slides onto a screen.

clue.text: Period in pub with alumnus at first displaying fixation

indicators.note: at first means placed at the front, ahead of the rest of the wordplay

blocks.note: OB, old boy, is a former pupil of a school
a session is a spell of drinking in a pub

explanation.surface: A former student's drinking session at the pub reveals an unhealthy fixation.
explanation.definitionFit: An obsession is a compulsive preoccupation, an idea or interest that dominates the mind.

clue.text: Millions extracted from newspaper associations

indicators.note: something extracted is pulled out and taken away, so a letter is removed

blocks.note: M is the abbreviation for million
The Times, a British daily newspaper

explanation.surface: Money being taken out of a newspaper company's links with others.
explanation.definitionFit: Ties are bonds or connections between people or groups, as in family ties.

clue.text: Current despondency unending in White House

indicators.note: with no end, the word loses its final letter

blocks.note: I is the symbol for electric current
gloom is low spirits

explanation.surface: Present gloom in the US presidential residence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'White House' looks like Washington; read literally it is a house made of snow.
explanation.definitionFit: An igloo is a dome-shaped Inuit shelter built from blocks of snow, so literally a white house.

clue.text: Gear sent out for Bilko perhaps

indicators.note: out here means disordered or out of place, so these letters are rearranged

blocks.note: the letters of these words, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Kit dispatched to an army sergeant from a TV comedy.
explanation.definitionFit: Sergeant Bilko is the scheming army sergeant of the 1950s American TV sitcom, so an example of the rank.

clue.text: Games with the French genius on pitch

blocks.note: PE, physical education, is school games
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Sporting contests featuring a French football genius.
explanation.definitionFit: Pelé, the Brazilian footballer, is widely regarded as the greatest player of all time.

clue.text: Allowed to suffer initial deprivation? Shocking

indicators.note: being deprived of the initial means losing the first letter of the word

blocks.note: permitted by law

explanation.surface: Someone permitted to go hungry from the start, which is described as shocking.
explanation.definitionFit: Awful and shocking are both everyday words for something very bad or appalling.

clue.text: Preacher lively sort full of charm

indicators.note: a thing full of something holds it inside, so one word sits within the other

blocks.note: a goer is an energetic, lively person
a charm is a magic spell

explanation.surface: A description of a charismatic, energetic preacher.
explanation.definitionFit: A gospeller is an evangelist, someone who reads or preaches the Gospel.

clue.text: Best study hard to get a grip on English

indicators.note: gripping something means holding it, so one piece goes inside the other

blocks.note: to cram is to study intensively before an exam
E is the abbreviation for English

explanation.surface: Advice for a student trying hard to master English.
explanation.definitionFit: The cream of something is its finest part, the elite, like cream rising to the top of milk.

clue.text: Dish in part served with seconds in box

indicators.note: the last in places one thing within the box mentioned after it

blocks.note: a case is a box
S is the abbreviation for seconds
an actor's part is a role

explanation.surface: A dish served in portions, with second helpings packed into a box.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Seconds' reads as second helpings of the dish, but it is just the abbreviation for the unit of time.
explanation.definitionFit: A casserole is a slow-cooked stew, and also the covered pot it is cooked and served in.

clue.text: Asian noodles course great – daughter tucked in

indicators.note: something tucked in is pushed inside, so one letter sits within the other pieces

blocks.note: a path is a course or route
A1 means first-rate, written with letters as AI
D is the abbreviation for daughter

explanation.surface: A restaurant review: a great noodle course, with a daughter tucking in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tucked in' suggests eating, which suits noodles, but here it puts D inside PATH.
explanation.definitionFit: Pad thai is a stir-fried rice noodle dish from Thailand, a staple of Southeast Asian cooking.

clue.text: His cup landlady emptied in corner bar

indicators.note: emptied means the middle is cleared out, leaving only the outside letters
in places the shortened word within the next one

blocks.note: to corner a market is to hog it, keep it all to yourself
taken as written before its middle goes
a rail is a bar

explanation.surface: A man's cup being drained by the landlady in the corner of a pub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'His' is Christ's: the capital-H cup of legend, disguised as any man's drink.
explanation.definitionFit: The Holy Grail is in legend the cup Christ drank from at the Last Supper, sought by Arthurian knights.

clue.text: Enthusiast in protest before noon

blocks.note: a demo is a demonstration, a protest march
N is the abbreviation for noon

explanation.surface: A keen campaigner turning up for a protest in the morning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'before' says DEMO comes ahead of N.
explanation.definitionFit: A demon at something is a person who does it with great energy and zeal, as in a demon for work.

clue.text: Raised velocity on walk in cosmic region

indicators.note: in a down clue raising a word lifts it bottom to top, so it reads backwards

blocks.note: speed is velocity
to pace is to walk steadily

explanation.surface: Picking up speed while walking through the cosmos.
explanation.definitionFit: Deep space is the far reaches of the universe, well beyond Earth's atmosphere and the Moon.

clue.text: Beastly comment about new diagram in treatise

indicators.note: about means going round, so one word surrounds a letter

blocks.note: a moo is what a cow says
N is the abbreviation for new
a graph is a diagram of data

explanation.surface: A sharp remark about a new figure in an academic paper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Beastly' suggests nastiness; here it means said by a beast, a cow.
explanation.definitionFit: A monograph is a detailed scholarly study of one subject, a kind of learned treatise.

clue.text: Spoilt brat shown on TV

blocks.note: an imp is a mischievous child
a programme on TV has been aired, broadcast

explanation.surface: A spoilt child shown on television.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spoilt' looks like it describes the brat; it is the definition, meaning damaged.
explanation.definitionFit: Impaired means damaged or weakened, so something spoilt in quality or function.

clue.text: Some extreme talent needed for heavy music

indicators.note: some of the words means only a portion of their letters, running across them

blocks.note: the letters run across the end of one word and the start of the next

explanation.surface: Playing heavy rock music demands exceptional ability.
explanation.definitionFit: Metal is short for heavy metal, a loud, guitar-driven style of rock.

clue.text: See 4
Artist cold in clear upper air

indicators.note: in places one letter inside the following word

blocks.note: the ether was thought to be the pure air of the heavens
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

explanation.surface: A painter chilled in the thin air of a mountain top.
explanation.definitionFit: An etcher makes prints by cutting designs into metal plates with acid, a kind of graphic artist.

clue.text: Port often chilled from main investor

blocks.note: arch as an adjective means chief or principal, as in arch-enemy
an angel is a private backer, especially of a theatre production

explanation.surface: A wine that is often served cold, made by a leading investor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Port' looks like the fortified wine, chilled; it is a harbour city, often icebound.
explanation.definitionFit: Archangel (Arkhangelsk) is a Russian seaport on the White Sea, frozen for much of the year.

clue.text: Regressing predictably involves drink

indicators.note: a word that involves another holds it within its letters
regressing means going backwards, so the letters are read in reverse

blocks.note: the run of letters inside this word, before being turned round

explanation.surface: Someone sliding back into an old habit, as expected, with drink involved.
explanation.definitionFit: Cider is an alcoholic drink made from fermented apple juice.

clue.text: Brill around river area

indicators.note: around means surrounding, so the first word wraps round the next

blocks.note: brill is slang for brilliant, and so is ace
R is the abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: A brill, the flatfish, swimming around a river.
explanation.walkthrough: Brill is a flatfish, but here it is British slang for brilliant.
explanation.definitionFit: An acre is a unit for measuring land area, about 4,047 square metres.

clue.text: Header missed in tight draw

indicators.note: a header missing means the top letter is dropped

blocks.note: tight and blotto are both slang for very drunk

explanation.surface: A missed header in a tight match that ends level.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Header' and 'draw' suggest football; tight means drunk, not close.
explanation.definitionFit: A lotto is a lottery, a game of chance in which winning numbers are drawn.

clue.text: Frigg ultimately appears in this swirling vision

indicators.note: ultimately means at the very end, so only the last letter is wanted
swirling letters are spun round into a new order
to appear in something is to be found inside it

blocks.note: taken as written, before being stirred up
the final letter of the goddess's name

explanation.surface: A Norse goddess turning up in a swirling, mystical vision.
explanation.walkthrough: Frigg is the wife of Odin in Norse myth; only her last letter is used.
explanation.definitionFit: Sight is the faculty of seeing, and also a thing seen, a vision or spectacle.

clue.text: Robin left-wing as Bert’s revolutionary

indicators.note: a revolutionary overturns things, so these letters are turned into a new order

blocks.note: red is the colour of socialism
the letters of these words, before being rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone called Robin is as much a left-wing radical as Bert is.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Robin' looks like a person's name; it is the bird.
explanation.definitionFit: Redbreast is an old name for the European robin, after the orange-red patch on its chest.

clue.text: Flooded? Get wife into a tree

indicators.note: getting something into a place puts it inside, as the following into confirms

blocks.note: taken as written
W is the abbreviation for wife
the ash is a common tree

explanation.surface: Escaping a flood by helping your wife up a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: Something awash is covered or swamped by water, as a deck is in heavy seas.

clue.text: Oscar cuts into overcooked fish

indicators.note: something that cuts into another goes inside it

blocks.note: overcooked food is dried out
Oscar is O in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A chef named Oscar slicing into a piece of fish that has been overdone.
explanation.definitionFit: The dory, or John Dory, is a flat-bodied edible sea fish.

clue.text: Larghetto e capriccioso: tutti?

indicators.note: capriccioso is the musical direction to play freely and whimsically, so these letters are played in a free order

blocks.note: the letters of these two Italian words

explanation.surface: A string of Italian musical directions: rather slow, then capricious, then everyone playing.
explanation.walkthrough: Larghetto means fairly slow; the question mark flags that tutti is defined loosely by its English sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Tutti is the Italian musical term for all performers playing at once, which in English is all together.
